plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Pabili uses your location to match nearby stores and, while you are online as a courier, to share your live position for active deliveries — even when the screen is locked.

plugins.photosPermission: Pabili needs your photos to attach pictures to orders and your profile.
plugins.cameraPermission: Pabili needs the camera to take product, pickup and delivery photos.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pabili uses your location to find nearby stores and couriers, and to set your pickup point for rides and deliveries.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: While you are Online as a courier or driver, Pabili shares your live location with the customer of your active delivery or ride — even when the screen is locked. Location is not shared when you are Offline.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pabili needs the camera to take product, pickup and delivery photos and your verification documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pabili needs your photos to attach pictures to orders, your profile and verification.
